events.title: El festival de otoño de 2026
events.description:
¡Acompáñenos en un día lleno de entretenimiento, creatividad y un toque de historia el sábado 17 de octubre, de 10AM a 3PM!

El Festival de Otoño regresa al Museo Dyckman Farmhouse con actividades familiares nuevas y divertidas, además de las favoritas del año pasado:

  • ¡Crea animaciones stop motion e ilusiones ópticas alucinantes inspiradas en el otoño! ¡Sí, has leído bien! ¡Venga a crear sus propios taumatropos y vea cómo sus dibujos cobran vida!
  • ¡Bebe sidra de manzana fresca de la prensa y elaborada frente a tus ojos!
  • ¡Bailar a la MÚSICA EN VIVO de sus músicos favoritos del barrio!
  • ¡Disfruta de una competencia amistosa! ¡Pon a prueba tu mano firme con Jenga gigante y ve cuánto tiempo puede durar tu torre! Tendremos un montón de juegos de césped para cualquiera listo para un desafío…
  • ¡Explora nuestra histórica cabaña de los soldados de Hesse y el famoso Museo de la Granja Dyckman de forma GRATUITA! Ven a descubrir

events.title: Fall Festival 2026
events.description:
THE WAIT IS FINALLY OVER!

The Annual Fall Festival returns to Dyckman Farmhouse Museum with exciting new activities plus the all-time favorites you’ve been waiting all year for:

  • Unleash your inner artist with fall-inspired stop motion animations and mind-bending optical illusions! Yes, you read that right! Come create your very own thaumatropes and spin your drawings to life!
  • Sip on apple cider fresh from the press and crafted right before your eyes!
  • Dance to LIVE MUSIC performed by your favorite local musicians!
  • Enjoy some neighborly competition! Put your steady hand to the test with giant Jenga and see how long your tower can last! We’ll have plenty of lawn games out for anyone up for a challenge…
  • Explore our historic Hessian Hut and the iconic Dyckman Farmhouse Museum FREE OF CHARGE! Come experience the magic of our latest contemporary exhibition by Jamaican

events.title: Opening Reception: Spot P!
events.description:
Come and celebrate the opening of Spot P! by Kasper Klop, Deron Gopie, and Morwenna Spagnol. Free and open to the public.

Peter Stuyvesant is often credited with laying the foundations for what became New York City. Today, this man of Dutch origin is celebrated all around town: statues, neighborhoods in his name, cigarette brand…

Yet, if we take a closer look, he was a trader and owner of enslaved Africans in the United States. Bolstered by his fortune and his influence, he sold enslaved people at public auction, held and expressed deeply antisemitic views, violently oppressed the Lenape, and actively suppressed religious minorities.
